gloss: arms and armor; weapons and military equipment

definitions.gloss: arms and armor; weapons and military equipment
definitions.explanation: A collective term covering weapons, armor, and other military equipment, especially from the samurai era. Includes both offensive items (swords, spears) and defensive items (armor, helmets).

examples.japanese: {博物館|はくぶつかん}に{武具|ぶぐ}が{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: Arms and armor are displayed at the museum.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}は{常|つね}に{武具|ぶぐ}の{手入|てい}れを{怠|おこた}らなかった。
examples.english: Samurai never neglected the maintenance of their arms and armor.

examples.japanese: {戦国時代|せんごくじだい}には、{刀|かたな}や{槍|やり}、{弓矢|ゆみや}など{様々|さまざま}な{武具|ぶぐ}が{戦|いくさ}で{使|つか}われた。
examples.english: During the Warring States period, various arms such as swords, spears, and bows and arrows were used in battle.

notes:
A collective term for weapons, armor, and other military equipment, especially from the samurai era. Encompasses both offensive items ({刀|かたな}, {槍|やり}, {弓|ゆみ}) and defensive items ({鎧|よろい}, {兜|かぶと}, {盾|たて}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {武具|ぶぐ}を{身|み}につける: to don arms and armor
- {武具|ぶぐ}の{手入|てい}れ: maintenance of arms
- {武具|ぶぐ}を{飾|かざ}る: to display arms and armor
- {武具|ぶぐ}{甲冑|かっちゅう}: arms and armor (emphatic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {武器|ぶき}: weapon — specifically offensive weapons, not armor; more general and modern
- {兵器|へいき}: arms, ordnance — modern military weapons and equipment
- {甲冑|かっちゅう}: armor (helmet and body armor) — specifically the defensive gear
